articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D Assets
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene descriptions in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench verified over GPT-5 and near-human performance on novel video understanding tasks. The model is available via API with a 1M token context and new structured-output guarantees for agentic workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Level on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 5 out of 6 problems on the 2026 IMO problem set under competition conditions, marking the first AI system to consistently reach gold-medal caliber on novel competition mathematics. The system combines a large reasoning model with a formal verification backend using Lean 4, allowing it to generate and verify proofs end-to-end. The result is considered a significant milestone in automated mathematical reasoning.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots have entered limited production deployment at two Gigafactory sites, performing bin-picking, parts inspection, and inter-station material transport tasks. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded dexterous hands with 22 degrees of freedom and an on-board vision-language model enabling natural-language task reassignment by line supervisors. Tesla reports a target of 1,000 deployed units across its own factories by Q1 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with 48-Hour Autonomous Operation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform, featuring hot-swappable battery modules enabling up to 48 hours of continuous autonomous operation in warehouse and logistics environments. The system leverages a new whole-body predictive control stack that reduces fall rates by 90% compared to earlier prototypes. Initial customers include DHL and Amazon, with pilot deployments beginning in early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework to Defend Against Jailbreak and Prompt Injection Attacks
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new defense architecture called Constitutional Classifiers, which layers lightweight classifier models trained via constitutional AI principles to detect and reject adversarial prompts in real time with sub-5ms latency overhead. In red-team evaluations, the system reduced successful jailbreak rates to under 0.3% across diverse attack taxonomies while preserving 99.1% of benign query throughput. The framework is open-sourced and designed to be model-agnostic.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Risk Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node has entered risk production, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap, using next-generation gate-all-around nanosheet transistors. The node promises an 18% speed improvement or 35% power reduction over N2, with design wins already secured from Apple, Nvidia, and AMD for 2027-2028 products. This positions TSMC to maintain its manufacturing lead amid intensifying competition from Samsung and Intel.

articles.title: Microsoft and Atom Computing Demonstrate 99.7% Two-Qubit Gate Fidelity in Neutral-Atom Quantum Processor
articles.summary: Microsoft and Atom Computing jointly reported achieving 99.7% two-qubit gate fidelity on a 1,225-qubit neutral-atom processor, crossing a critical threshold for practical quantum error correction at scale. The result was achieved using mid-circuit measurement and real-time feed-forward on a reconfigurable atom array, bringing fault-tolerant quantum computing closer to commercial viability. Microsoft plans to integrate the system into its Azure Quantum platform for early-access research workloads in 2027.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production for Commercial Logistics
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at an $18 billion valuation, led by Microsoft and joined by Nvidia and Bezos Expeditions, to scale manufacturing of its Figure 03 humanoid robot. The company plans to open a dedicated production facility in Texas targeting 10,000 units per year by late 2027, with BMW and Amazon as anchor customers. Figure 03 integrates a fine-tuned multimodal foundation model for real-time task planning and human-robot collaboration on unstructured tasks.
